svg.title: PrepAI — Research Poster
svg.desc: Academic research poster for an AI-guided interview practice prototype. User-provided study claims are marked for verification.
svg.text: A guided practice prototype for building interview confidence through structured, actionable feedback

text.tspan: Practice can be hard to structure and repeat.
Learners may lack focused questions, clear
feedback, and guidance about what to practise

svg.text: DESIGN QUESTION · How can practice feel actionable?

text.tspan: • Build guided topic and mock-interview practice.
• Give answer estimates and reviewable feedback.
• Adapt question selection and show practice history.
• Validate user needs and usability with learners.

svg.text: Personas are draft; validate with interview notes.
Draft personas; validate against coded interview evidence.

text.tspan: • The prototype uses a traditional ML short-answer
scoring pipeline and a relevance guard.
• Adaptive topic selection is a separate policy; practice
history stays in browser storage (no remote database).

svg.text: Scores are estimates; short-answer training may not transfer to long interview answers.
